last_batch.research: PubMed E-utilities searches covered 30 final fresh non-prescription psoriasis self-management topics. The final query set returned 175 unique PubMed PMIDs, 174 fetched article records, and 170 abstracts available for inspection. Retained numeric effects or valid relative effects were verified for PMID records: 40991259, 41416383, 33183899, 36988936, 9555791, 31453631, 8765459, 15857459, 19015420, 35347400, 20840347, 33236826, 39319513, 38020146, 9111831, 41953712, 27508937, 24641585, 28541882, and 30646223. Twenty retained PubMed references were added across 18 new entries. New entries cover Mediterranean diet, weight loss, oral vitamin D, omega-3 lipid emulsion, probiotics, aloe vera cream, indigo naturalis ointment, balneotherapy, Dead Sea salt-bath phototherapy, salt-bath phototherapy, narrowband UV-B phototherapy, excimer laser, acupuncture, mindfulness, internet CBT, exercise, patient education, and teledermatology. Gluten-free diet, curcumin, emollient, moisturizer, acupressure, yoga, stress management, aerobic exercise, resistance exercise, sleep intervention, smoking cessation, and alcohol reduction topics were screened out because the retrieved PubMed records did not provide a retained topic-specific numeric intervention-versus-control result or valid relative effect. Six truthful thin-study warnings remain for the 22-person excimer comparison, 42-person indigo trial, 38-person Mediterranean trial, and 22-person patient-education trial, including the prior thin-study backlog.
